subject: ACME renewal & expansion — usage review & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme.com>, John Bailey <j.bailey@acme.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: ACME renewal & expansion — usage review & next steps

Hi Elena & John,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the candid discussion about current usage and the new workloads you expect next year. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of what we covered:
- Current seat & capacity: ACME is using the Redwood hosted API with a mix of embeddings and chat generation. Q2-Q3 usage spiked during marketing campaigns; steady-state token consumption is ~350M tokens/month.
- Pain points:
  * Latency variability on long chat sessions (esp. >2k tokens) impacting user experience.
  * Cost sensitivity on high-volume embedding workloads for search (looking to reduce unit cost / token).
  * Need for private networking for PII-sensitive prompts later this year (legal requirement).
- Goals for renewal/expansion:
  * Secure a 12-month renewal with improved unit economics (target ~15% cost reduction).
  * Add Dedicated capacity for embeddings workload to control cost and guarantee throughput.
  * Evaluate Private (VPC) option for the PII workloads with a Q4 pilot.

Proposed upsell path & timeline:
1) Near-term: Renewal for hosted API (current terms) + a 10% committed capacity add-on for embeddings to test batching/quant profiles — target close by Sept 10.
2) Mid-term (Q4): Pilot Dedicated pool for embeddings (4 GPUs) + performance/latency benchmark.
3) Longer-term (Q4–Q1): Private deployment discussion for PII workloads (legal sign-off + deployment planning).

Open items / asks from ACME:
- Can you confirm the expected steady-state tokens for embeddings vs chat for budgeting? (John — you mentioned a 3x increase in embeddings traffic).
- Legal: any timeline for privacy & compliance review?

Attachments I’m sharing:
- ACME_usage_report_Q3.pdf — usage breakout and latency percentiles from last 90 days.
- SOW_draft_v2.docx — initial scope for Dedicated pilot and timeline.

Next steps (proposed):
- Elena: confirm numbers for embeddings steady-state by Thu 8/27.
- Marissa & David: update SOW with Dedicated sizing and send formal renewal quote by Mon 8/30.
- Schedule a 30-min benchmark review (Vivek to run metrics) the week of 9/6 if pilot is greenlit.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: ACME_usage_report_Q3.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: SOW_draft_v2.docx (docx, 56KB)]

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme.com>

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME renewal & expansion — usage review & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good summary and thanks for the report. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Confirming John’s note: embeddings volume will increase roughly 3x starting Oct after the search rollout.
- Latency: we can provide a list of user flows that are most impacted by the long chat sessions — aim to send by EOD 8/27.
- Legal & privacy: we’ve started the internal review; procurement expects to engage legal formally in mid-September. No blocker for a Sep renewal but pilot for Private will need legal sign-off before deployment.

On the SOW: procurement asked if you can spell out acceptance criteria for the Dedicated pilot (latency targets, throughput, and rollback conditions).

Proposed timeline OK from our side — we’d like to lock renewal terms before our Oct usage spike.

Elena

Elena — thanks, and that timeline makes sense. I attached an updated SOW (v2) that includes:
- Dedicated pilot acceptance criteria (p99 latency < 750ms for 2k token sessions, embedding throughput > 300 reqs/sec sustained for 30m),
- Rollback conditions (if we can’t meet p95 latency targets during benchmark window),
- Pricing for Dedicated pilot and the committed capacity discount option for hosted.

I also included an initial renewal quote summary in the SOW doc. Notes/asks from our side:
- John: can you confirm the 3x embeddings projection in writing so I can lock the committed capacity sizing?
- Procurement: please confirm if DocuSign is your preferred route for the renewal + SOW.

Next actions I’ll take:
- Finalize quote and send formal renewal package by Mon 8/30 (David will run final econs).
- Schedule benchmark review with Vivek for week of 9/6 if you greenlight pilot.

Regards,
Marissa
